units.source_text: 黑下83时，名人迫不及待，猛然站起来，顿时全身疲惫不堪。

en.t: When Black played move 83, the Master could wait no longer and suddenly stood up, his whole body at once overcome with exhaustion.

units.source_text: 这时是十二时二十七分，当然是午休时间。

en.t: It was then twelve twenty-seven, naturally the time for the midday break.

units.source_text: 名人不顾一切地站立起来，这种情况以前没有过。

en.t: The Master stood up without regard for anything else; nothing like this had ever happened before.
